source_name: BQK — Vendimet e Bordit Ekzekutiv / Decisions of the Executive Board
why_relevant: BQK Executive Board decisions are the legally mandated act by which bank/MFI/NBFI/PSP licences, preliminary approvals and (per licensing manuals) senior-management and board approvals are granted. Individual dated decision posts name institutions and, in many cases, the approved persons or the licence action behind a leadership move.

source_name: BQK — CBK Odluke Odbora (Serbian-language Board decisions section)
why_relevant: Serbian-language mirror of the CBK Board decisions section — needed for Serb-majority-market coverage and gives an alternate term set ('odluke odbora', 'imenovanje uprave') for query expansion and for matching decisions that only surface in one language edition.

source_name: BQK — 'Bank Directors and Senior Managers' supervisory instruction/form
why_relevant: Defines who counts as a director/senior manager subject to CBK fit-and-proper approval (CEO, deputy CEO, CFO, COO, CRO and others CBK designates). This is the schema that tells a collector which roles legally generate a public CBK approval event — essential for scoping A5 leadership-move monitoring.

source_name: BQK — Manuali i Licencimit Bankar / Banking Licensing Manual (sq + en)
why_relevant: Sets the procedure and 90-day deadlines for licence decisions and the documentation required for proposed directors and senior managers. Gives the expected lag between an appointment and its public CBK record — the timing model for the monitoring pipeline.

source_name: BQK — Manuali i Regjistrimit të Institucioneve Mikrofinanciare dhe IFJB
why_relevant: Non-bank leg of the same regime: registration/approval procedure for MFIs and non-bank financial institutions (which in Kosovo include many payment/FX actors), including management-approval requirements. Extends A5 coverage beyond banks into the payments-adjacent institution set.

source_name: BQK — Lista e institucioneve financiare të licencuara/regjistruara (licensed institutions list)
why_relevant: The authoritative periodically-reissued roster of licensed banks, MFIs, NBFIs, insurers and payment actors. Dated reissues make it a change-detection source: new entrants, withdrawn licences and renamed entities are organization-change signals, and it is the master actor list that every other A5 query keys off.

source_name: BQK — Struktura organizative (organizational structure / org chart)
why_relevant: CBK's own published org chart and department pages (e.g. Financial Supervision) — the baseline for detecting supervisor-side reorganisations, new departments/divisions and reporting-line changes, which precede or explain supervisory-priority shifts.

source_name: BQK — Bordi Ekzekutiv / Executive Board member pages
why_relevant: Names and bios of the Governor and deputy governors, i.e. CBK's own leadership. Direct primary record for supervisor-side leadership moves; page edits are the earliest public confirmation of a deputy-governor change.

source_name: BQK — Raporti Vjetor / Annual Report (and archive)
why_relevant: Annual reports carry the governance chapter, staff/headcount figures, organizational structure annex and a narrative of supervisory activity for the year — the retrospective, citable anchor for org-change and staffing trends at the supervisor, published in sq, sr and en.

source_name: BQK — Konkurse të punës / Job Vacancies (+ archive)
why_relevant: CBK's own hiring board, with a dated archive. Vacancy titles and their departments reveal supervisor capacity-building and new functions (e.g. crypto-asset, payments oversight units) months before an org chart changes — the strongest leading indicator in this cell for the 'jobs/hiring' topic.

source_name: BQK — Rregullore për Qeverisjen Korporative të Bankave (corporate governance regulation)
why_relevant: The binding rule on bank board composition, committee structure, independence and management appointment/notification duties. It defines what an entity must disclose and when — i.e. the legal trigger list for every leadership/organization event this workstream should expect to see.

source_name: BQK — Rregullore për licencimin e operatorëve të kripto-aseteve (crypto-asset operator licensing)
why_relevant: A new licensing category (2025) means a new stream of CBK approvals covering management fit-and-proper for crypto/payments-adjacent operators, plus a likely new supervisory unit and hiring at CBK. Marks an expanding perimeter for A5 leadership-move records.

source_name: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës (GZK) — official gazette / legal acts portal
why_relevant: Publishes the Law on CBK (03/L-209), the Law on Banks/MFIs/NBFIs (04/L-093) and the 2026 new Law on Banks (08/L-304) — the statutes that create the appointment-approval duty — plus assembly decisions on CBK board/governor appointments. Independent of bqk-kos.org, so it is the fallback record when the CBK site is unreachable.

source_name: Ligji Nr. 08/L-304 për Bankat (2026 new Banking Law, as published)
why_relevant: The newly enacted banking law (Official Gazette Nr.2, 27 Jan 2026) resets fit-and-proper, board-approval and licence-revocation rules. Any change in what CBK must approve or publish about bank management flows from this text; it also signals a wave of re-approvals across the sector.

source_name: Kuvendi i Kosovës — plenary decisions and Committee on Budget, Labour and Transfers
why_relevant: The Assembly elects the CBK Governor and appoints CBK Board members on the Budget Committee's proposal (e.g. Ahmet Ismaili elected Governor 13 July 2023). Committee agendas, vacancy calls and plenary transcripts are the primary record of supervisor-leadership change and its timing.

source_name: ARBK — Kosovo Business Registration Agency public register
why_relevant: Statutory registry of company officers: a CBK-approved board or CEO change must also be filed at ARBK, and the ARBK record often carries the exact date and the person's identity even when the CBK notice is terse. Cross-checking ARBK against the CBK licensed-institution list is the practical way to timestamp leadership moves at banks, MFIs and PSPs.

source_name: ARBK Open / arbk.atlas-studio.eu — third-party mirrors of the Kosovo business register
why_relevant: Open re-publications of ARBK data with full-text search by owner, name, NUI, municipality and sector — far more tractable for automated officer-change monitoring than the official portal, and useful as a change-detection layer that points back to the authoritative ARBK record.

source_name: Zyra Kombëtare e Auditimit (National Audit Office) — audit reports
why_relevant: External audits of public institutions expose governance weaknesses, vacant or acting senior posts, staffing shortfalls and organizational findings that institutions do not volunteer. Reports naming CBK or financial-sector oversight give an independent read on supervisor organization and capacity.

source_name: env2.bqk-kos.org — CBK staging/mirror host
why_relevant: A second CBK host indexed by search engines that exposes the English URL scheme for Executive Board decisions and financial statements. Useful for reverse-engineering canonical paths on the main site and as an alternate retrieval route if the primary host blocks a collector.

source_name: BQK — Ligji për Sistemin e Pagesave / Law on Payment System (04/L-155)
why_relevant: Establishes CBK licensing and oversight of payment-system operators and payment institutions, including the requirements applying to their management. This is the statutory hook that makes payments-sector leadership moves a published regulatory event rather than private corporate news.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Kosovo — Media / Lajme (newsroom)
why_relevant: Official newsroom of the largest RBI subsidiary in Kosovo; publishes corporate announcements including management changes, reorganizations and senior appointments. English mirror exists at /en/about-us/media/.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Kosovo — Bordi Menaxhues (Management Board) page
why_relevant: Canonical roster of the Management Board (CEO plus Retail, Operations/IT and Risk board members). Snapshot-diffing this page detects appointments and departures even when no press release is issued.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Kosovo — Karriera / recruitment portal
why_relevant: Own vacancy channel plus a dedicated applicant-tracking portal (recruit.raiffeisen-kosovo.com) and a 'Tech4Tech' community page; vacancy titles are the leading indicator of new divisions, digital/IT build-out and organizational restructuring.

source_name: ProCredit Bank Kosovë — Lajme / News
why_relevant: Newsroom of the leading SME bank in Kosovo; carries corporate announcements and, historically, management-level news. sq path /shq/lajme/ hosts individual items.

source_name: ProCredit Bank Kosovë — Bordi Menaxhues (Management Board)
why_relevant: Roster page under 'struktura e bankës' (bank structure) — the exact page that changes when a management board member is appointed or leaves; sibling pages under struktura-e-bankes describe organizational structure.

source_name: ProCredit Holding AG — group press releases / ad-hoc disclosures
why_relevant: ProCredit's Kosovo subsidiary is owned by a Frankfurt-listed holding that is legally obliged to disclose management-board and supervisory-board changes; group disclosures often name subsidiary CEOs (e.g. the Kosovo GM being appointed and the group chair transition) before or instead of local newsroom items.

source_name: NLB Banka sh.a. Prishtinë — Management Board page
why_relevant: NLB Kosovo publishes its management board roster on an HR-subdomain site; the HR subdomain also implies employer-branding and vacancy content, covering both leadership and hiring topics.
